description: Inline, non-blocking recoverable-error card for the onboarding flow (invite failed, link failed, complete failed). Same noticeCard pattern the calendar/dashboard error states use. Never blocks the user from proceeding.

message.description: Recoverable, reassuring copy (e.g. "Couldn't send the invite — you can add your partner later in Settings.")

accessibility.note: icon + word + color; retry is a labeled button with >=44pt target
